audit_type: Package-wide general audit of the personal/original CS & AI Mastery build

important_gaps_found_and_fixed.finding: Embedded Systems, Systems Programming, and Advanced Computer Organization had no knowledge checks.
important_gaps_found_and_fixed.fix: Added 24 curated job-relevant MCQs to each course (72 total), and added visible Knowledge checks sections/rendering to their static course pages.

important_gaps_found_and_fixed.finding: Those same three systems courses contained 38 repeated generic exercise prompts.
important_gaps_found_and_fixed.fix: Replaced all 38 with distinct job-style tasks tied to the lesson's real engineering behavior.

important_gaps_found_and_fixed.finding: 24 lessons in the three systems courses were missing common-mistake guidance.
important_gaps_found_and_fixed.fix: Added course-specific common mistakes to all 24 lessons.

important_gaps_found_and_fixed.finding: 13 courses were missing explicit career/company-use descriptions.
important_gaps_found_and_fixed.fix: Added careerApplications to all 13 and kept the company-use-only curriculum gate.

important_gaps_found_and_fixed.finding: Advanced Computer Organization lesson aco-5 had an explanation that was too short.
important_gaps_found_and_fixed.fix: Expanded associativity, replacement policy, and write-policy reasoning.

important_gaps_found_and_fixed.finding: Static HTML had unlabeled theme controls and code textareas, concentrated in the three manually authored systems pages.
important_gaps_found_and_fixed.fix: Added stable accessible names/labels and updated the static-page generator so future builds preserve them.

important_gaps_found_and_fixed.finding: After adding knowledge-check data, the three systems pages still needed a visible knowledge-check host/renderer.
important_gaps_found_and_fixed.fix: Added the Knowledge checks section and assessment-practice renderer to all three pages; regression test now enforces this.

verification.secret_scan: PASS — no real GitHub token, private key, AWS access key, .env file, .git directory, or Windows user path detected
verification.static_accessibility: PASS — no missing accessible names in audited static controls/textareas

notes: The personal GitHub integration remains part of this build.
A broad automated audit can catch structural/runtime/content regressions, but it cannot guarantee that no future device/browser-specific issue will ever appear.
The final ZIP is re-tested after fresh extraction before delivery.
